brief.purpose: A local-first co-creative studio where designers and frontend builders work with AI to develop rough drafts into polished, editable, runnable interfaces
brief.concept: Refine the already selected uppercase-D logo direction without changing its identity. Preserve this exact architecture: one tall violet rounded rectangular spine on the left; one sky-blue curved facet forming the upper-right D bowl; one coral curved facet forming the lower-right D bowl; and one small sun-yellow lens, wedge, or concave diamond at the shared center seam. The three main colored parts collaborate to form one unmistakable capital D. Derive variations only through proportion, curve tension, seam geometry, corner radius, and the size or shape of the yellow inspiration point. The violet spine may subtly suggest stacked draft edges, but do not turn it into a literal document. Do not introduce new symbols, lowercase d, additional letters, full words, writing lines, robots, browser windows, cursors, code brackets, chat bubbles, flowers, or generic AI sparkles
brief.style: Production-ready brand-logo refinements of one coherent uppercase-D identity; creative, optimistic, collaborative, and precise. Compact flat-vector geometry, three bold color fields plus the small yellow junction, clear capital-D silhouette at 16 px, strong one-color fallback. No illustration scene, gradients, gloss, texture, thin lines, tiny details, shadows, enclosing tile, or mockup
brief.palette: violet spine #6C21F5, sky-blue upper bowl #27ADEE, coral lower bowl #FF5038, sun-yellow junction #FFC827; no green
